_comment: api block = the Blizzard Game Data feed — HOST-SIDE ONLY, optional. One install's credentials fan the dump out through the backend upload, so players never create API clients. Never ship or reuse someone else's credentials; abuse lands on their account. Only useful on realms Blizzard covers (private realms don't resolve — the block no-ops). realms maps our scope name to the connected-realm ID (0 = resolve via the realm index). Machine-local — never commit real secrets.
_comment_backend: backend block = the crowdsourced GoblinMind feed (WoWVault/Proposals/api-feed-proposal.md). url points at a goblin_server.py instance; the bearer token auto-registers into api_state.json on first use — no player setup, no shipped secret. scopes = your GM.Scope() names. upload=false makes a read-only client. Machine-local — never shipped. key = the shared secret ONLY when the host gates registration via goblin_server.json (trusted LAN default); open backends leave it unset.
